api/Global.LHH_TestSDK.html.summary: Class LHH_TestSDK Entry point for automated tests against a device build from the Unity Editor (NUnit, Edit Mode or Play Mode). Inheritance System.Object LHH_TestSDK Namespace: Global Assembly: LHH.TestSDK.Docs.dll Syntax public sealed class LHH_TestSDK : MonoBehaviour Remarks First API call on a run: connect to Test Controller, lease device, Appium session, wait for player hub. Configure via menu LHH Test SDK - Settings (gRPC, platform, app path, bundle id). Requires LHH_AUTOMATION_TEST and a running Test Controller. Editor-only; not in player builds. Methods CleanUpAfterTest() Returns the leased device to the Test Controller and resets setup state for the next run. Declaration public static void CleanUpAfterTest() Remarks Called automatically when the Unity Test Runner finishes a run or reports a runner error. Manual calls are rarely needed; use only if you run tests outside the Test Runner or need early teardown. ClickButton(string, float) Waits for a UI object, then invokes its Unity UI Button onClick in the running game. Declaration public static Task ClickButton(string buttonPath, float timeoutSeconds = 30) Parameters Type Name Description string buttonPath Hierarchy path with / separators (root via GameObject.Find, children via Transform.Find). float timeoutSeconds Maximum seconds to wait for the button object before failing. Returns Type Description Task Remarks Runs implicit setup on first use, then WaitForObject(buttonPath) before click. Not for native store UI; use PurchaseByButton for IAP buy buttons. Examples await LHH_TestSDK.ClickButton( "PopupManager/ShopConfirmPopup(Clone)/Panel/Background/Button Confirm"); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Setup failed, hub command failed, or click could not run. TimeoutException Object not found before timeoutSeconds elapses. GetGameData(string) Reads PlayerPrefs from the game player for the given key (returned as string). Declaration public static Task<string> GetGameData(string key) Parameters Type Name Description string key PlayerPrefs key, e.g. coin or heart. Returns Type Description Task<string> Int, float, or string value encoded as string (player tries int, then float, then string). Remarks Runs implicit setup on first use. Parse in tests with int.TryParse etc. Examples string raw = await LHH_TestSDK.GetGameData("coin"); Assert.IsTrue(int.TryParse(raw, out int coins)); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Setup failed or the player could not read the key. GetText(string, float) Waits for a UI object, then reads displayed text from the running game player. Declaration public static Task<string> GetText(string textPath, float timeoutSeconds = 30) Parameters Type Name Description string textPath Hierarchy path with / separators (same rules as ClickButton and WaitForObject). float timeoutSeconds Maximum seconds to wait for the object before failing. Returns Type Description Task<string> Text content reported by the player for the object at textPath. Remarks Runs implicit setup on first use, then WaitForObject(textPath) before reading. Supports Unity UI Text and TextMeshPro on the target GameObject. Examples string label = await LHH_TestSDK.GetText("HUD/CoinLabel"); Assert.IsTrue(int.TryParse(label, out int coins)); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Setup failed, hub command failed, or text could not be read. TimeoutException Object not found before timeoutSeconds elapses. LogError(string) Writes a message to the Unity Console in red (calls LogWithColor with red). Declaration public static void LogError(string message) Parameters Type Name Description string message Text to log. Remarks Use for assertion detail without failing the test until you call NUnit Assert. LogWithColor(string, Color) Writes a message to the Unity Console with the given color (rich text). Declaration public static void LogWithColor(string message, Color color) Parameters Type Name Description string message Text to log. Color color Color applied to the message in the Console window. Remarks Does not contact the Test Controller; safe to use anywhere in a test. Purchase(string) Starts in-app purchase by store catalog product id (no in-game button click). Declaration public static Task Purchase(string catalogProductId) Parameters Type Name Description string catalogProductId IAP product id configured in the game. Returns Type Description Task Remarks Controller sends purchase to the Unity player, then drives the native store sheet. Prefer PurchaseByButton when the test must tap a shop UI element. Examples await LHH_TestSDK.Purchase("com.example.coins_1000"); Exceptions Type Condition ArgumentException catalogProductId is null or whitespace. InvalidOperationException Setup failed, purchase failed, or timed out (3 minutes). PurchaseByButton(string) Clicks an in-game shop buy button and completes purchase via the native store UI. Declaration public static Task<bool> PurchaseByButton(string buttonPath) Parameters Type Name Description string buttonPath Hierarchy path to a Unity UI Button (same format as WaitForObject). Returns Type Description Task<bool> True if the Test Controller reports success; false otherwise. Remarks Controller taps the button, waits for the IAP sheet, and confirms buy. Use ClickButton for non-IAP UI. Use Purchase when you have a catalog product id instead of a button path. Examples bool ok = await LHH_TestSDK.PurchaseByButton( "__VIEWS__/Shop/.../Button Buy"); Assert.IsTrue(ok); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Setup failed, or the purchase client is not initialized. WaitForObject(string, float) Blocks until a GameObject exists in the game player hierarchy at the given path. Declaration public static Task WaitForObject(string objectPath, float timeoutSeconds = 30) Parameters Type Name Description string objectPath Hierarchy path with / separators (same rules as ClickButton). float timeoutSeconds Maximum seconds to wait before throwing. Returns Type Description Task Remarks Polls every 2 seconds. Runs implicit setup on first use. Examples await LHH_TestSDK.WaitForObject("iap_manager", timeoutSeconds: 30f); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Implicit setup failed. TimeoutException Object not found before timeoutSeconds elapses. WaitForScene(string, float) Blocks until a loaded scene with the given name is active in the game player. Declaration public static Task WaitForScene(string waitScene, float timeoutSeconds = 30) Parameters Type Name Description string waitScene Scene name to match (case-sensitive), compared against all currently loaded scenes. float timeoutSeconds Maximum time to wait before failing the test. Returns Type Description Task Remarks Polls every 2 seconds. Runs implicit setup on first use. Examples await LHH_TestSDK.WaitForScene("Home", timeoutSeconds: 50f); Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Implicit setup failed. TimeoutException No matching scene before timeoutSeconds elapses.

index.html.title: LHH Test SDK | LHH Test SDK
index.html.summary: LHH Test SDK Use LHH_TestSDK from NUnit tests in the Unity Editor to drive a real device build through the Test Controller: game UI, waits, PlayerPrefs checks, and in-app purchases. This site has two parts (as we add them): Section Purpose Manual Setup, settings, how to write your first test, object paths Scripting API Generated reference for LHH_TestSDK from XML doc comments in code Before you write tests Install the Test SDK in your Unity project. Start the Test Controller (and Appium) on your machine or CI agent. Open LHH Test SDK → Settings and set gRPC address, platform, app path, and bundle id. Quick example [Test] public async Task Shop_opens_on_home() { await LHH_TestSDK.WaitForScene("Home", timeoutSeconds: 50f); await LHH_TestSDK.WaitForObject("iap_manager"); await LHH_TestSDK.ClickButton("__VIEWS__/Shop/.../Open Shop"); } Requires Unity 2022.3.67f2 or newer.
